description: kitr new --kit desktop: The app kit in an Electron shell with a typed IPC contract and native dialogs. See the tauri kit for a Tauri shell.

kitr.name: desktop
kitr.title: Desktop kit
kitr.summary: Start the app kit in an Electron shell with a typed IPC contract and native dialogs.

kit.audience: Teams shipping a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux who want it to look the same on every machine.

highlights.title: The dashboard in Electron
highlights.text: The same app runs in a window and, with `kitr dev site`, in a browser.

highlights.title: A typed IPC contract
highlights.text: `app/ipc.ts` declares what the app may ask the main process, and both sides are type-checked.

highlights.title: Native dialogs and the OS
highlights.text: The home page opens a file dialog, keeps a secret in the OS vault and sends a notification.

highlights.title: Ready to package
highlights.text: `platforms/app/` holds the Electron main process and the electron-builder config.
